notes.title: Update Version 1.5 - Interactivity!
notes.notes:
Hello my friends!
Here a new cool update for you, here the add-ons ːwoodlefatherː

- Soul customization! ːespritː (you will change colour based on the books you'll read, aquiring self knowledge)

- Interaction with other players! (you'll be able to interact with some object on the island, for example a ball!)

- Number of items collected saved! (you can quit the game and then the status will be saved)

	

Hope you'll like this new super update :)

notes.title: New Update 1.45! - Vahid edition
notes.notes:
Hello Soul Mates! 
Here a new fresh update for Paradise Island!

- A LOT of fishes added!
- Jump! (Levitation)
- Mushrooms (in forest)
- Moving Curtains
- Minor Collision problems fixed

Thanks again for the fantastic support! Stay tuned for further updates! ːthetreeoflifeː
